title: NAFEMS LE5 Z-section cantilever (hex20)
source: NAFEMS, The Standard NAFEMS Benchmarks, TNSB Rev. 3, October 1990, test LE5 (target: axial stress −108 MPa at A, mid-surface); the problem and target as reproduced in the Abaqus 2016 Benchmarks Guide, section 4.2.5 'LE5: Z-section cantilever', and in the ESRD StressCheck Benchmarks Guide 'The Standard NAFEMS Benchmarks: Linear Elastic Tests' (2018), p. 15

quantities.quantity: σ_xx at A (2.5, −1, −1), mid-surface of the lower flange at its free edge
quantities.reason: the target is published to three figures and comes from a thin-walled idealisation; a 3D solid model of the section converges about 1.5% beyond it (ours: −109.46 here, −109.60 on the next mesh; ESRD's p-version solid: −109.5, see README)
